info.name: Commvault Automation Agents Storage Policies API

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all storage policies configured in the CommServe. Storage policies define where backup data is stored and how it is managed across primary, secondary, and tertiary storage tiers.

params.name: storagePolicyId
params.description: Unique identifier for the storage policy

items.docs: Retrieves detailed configuration of a specific storage policy, including its copies, retention rules, deduplication settings, and associated media agents.
